description: [roadmap S3.4] Settles U-1701. The six `Tree Cerc` / `Tree Drac` loads are loadWorldAssets' (0x00441e13 .. 0x00441e7f lie in loadWorldAssets 0x0043dbe0 .. 0x00442180; loadInterfaceArt reaches them through its loadWorldAssets call), table kWaGTrop of menu_flics.inc, course type 2 (tropical) only. Both the v1.03 exe and the v1.00 exe name `trees\Tropic\Tree Cerc\` (with a space, also PalCerc); the install, the v1.03 patch and the InstallShield cab (extracted/cab/Program_Files_(ENGLISH)/Flics/Trees/Tropic/Tree_Cerc) hold Tree_Cerc / Tree_Drac. Recorded (re/tools/flic_cells_rec.py, cov_b_s34_hawaii/stock, hooks off, instances\s3_4): the shadow's fileExists fails, flicOpenStream on `flics\trees\Tropic\Tree Cerc\Cerc_Small.flc` (slot 402 = 0x192) returns 0 and stores count 0, and the game dies within the next 180 s with no further message (c3fyb's exception report for the same load: access violation reading 0x8 at 0x00473e67, Image_draw on the NULL frame Surface, called from 0x0043d990, which is called from 0x00441e18). So no tropical course runs in the original on the shipped install; the tree sprites are not absent, the process ends. With copies under the exe's names in the instance (--tree-alias) the original loads all 114 tropical world loads and the port decodes every one equal.

[roadmap S3.4] The port diverges from the original on every tropical course: menu.cpp load_flic takes 0 columns for the missing `Tree Cerc` / `Tree Drac` files (flic_cols) and runs on, while the original dies at the first of them (U-1330). The decoder reports the case as kMainOpenFailed and makes no cells. Which behaviour the port gives (a Fault in the `original` profile plus a switch that reads the install's Tree_Cerc / Tree_Drac names, or the current run-on) is a decision: the alias changes the sheet's columns, which decide later cell allocations (sim state through the cell addresses mainLoop stores), so it is an `ask` under S6's D5 rule.
needed: The lead's / Mariano's choice; then a defect row in re/port/defect_decisions.tsv and the switch in menu.cpp

description: [roadmap S3.4] Which palette the original draws a sheet cell with is not determined here. cropSprite gives the cell's jgld Sprite the working image's palette (its handle slot +0xe8), which reads 0 in every recorded load (Sprite word m_10 = 0 in every recorded cell with cropSprite result 0, checked by port/test/test_flic.py); the flic's colour chunks go to the palette object at +4 of the frame-table record 0x004e9aa0 + 0x58 * slot (recorded and decoded equal for every load). flic::sheet_to_gfx hands the backend the slot palette as RGB555 for each cell; the sprite-queue step must check that against the draw path (drawQueuedSprite -> Image_draw -> Sprite::drawB with a NULL sprite palette).
